summary: BioVie filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering plus concurrent private placement under a November 3, 2026 securities purchase agreement with one institutional investor. Terms: 960,000 Class A shares at $1.60, and 2,002,500 pre-funded warrants at $1.5999 (exercise $0.0001, immediately exercisable until fully exercised), plus 2,962,500 common warrants exercisable six months post-issuance at $1.70, expiring five years after the initial exercise date. Gross proceeds were about $4.74 million, closing November 5, 2026; proceeds fund working capital and general purposes. Customary lock-up/standstill covenants and indemnities apply; no board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution overhang and warrant-related selling pressure.
